Meet my first public Grok @bot “MCP Expert”: https://x.ai/bot/7xSkMMmBQoQJmyuXTSYhx

Used it to collaborate with my Cursor Cloud agent to build custom mcps/connectors to websites. 

Will be sharing my Tesla MCP soon too.

Why MCPs/connectors? 
👉🏼 Your AI goes from blindly running around a website to knowing exactly where to go
👉🏼 Faster, consistent data gathering

Happy vibe coding 🙌🏽💪🏽
